annotations.title: Make a personal session from words

description: Use this when an adult describes in their own words what a session should be about and wants one made just for them, in a host that allows free text. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for choosing an existing session (use find_sessions).

tap.description: The 18+ tap token returned by keep_progress for this conversation; leave empty if there is none.

wish.description: The listener''s wish in their own words, up to 200 characters, no personal details needed.
examples: a short session to let go of a hard day
